text:
Alex (People Ops): Dropping a short, copy-first bundle for goal-setting + feedback. Designed for busy teams: calendar blurb, 1-paragraph self-review, manager micro-agenda, peer prompt, and a tiny calibration card. Please adapt and post versions here.
Hina (Eng Manager): this is great. calendar blurb I can paste?
Alex (People Ops): calendar blurb: 'Mid-cycle sync — 20m to share progress, call out one blocker, and agree one concrete support action. Bring your 1-paragraph self-summary.'
Jordan (SWE): pasteable 1-paragraph self-review please (devs will copy verbatim).
Alex (People Ops): 1-paragraph self-review (copy/paste):
```
Role & scope: [one line].
Top outcomes this cycle (1-2 bullets, include links/metrics): [bullets].
Key tradeoffs / what I learned: [one line].
Blocker I need help with: [one sentence].
Growth ask for next cycle: [one sentence].
```
Priya (PM): can we get a micro-agenda for a 20m 1:1?
Alex (People Ops): 20m manager micro-agenda:
- 3m: headline outcome (metric/link)
- 7m: blocker(s) & context
- 7m: manager commits & decisions (who, what, by when)
- 3m: career pulse / next step
Hina (Eng Manager): calibration shorthand? we need something quick for review docs.
Alex (People Ops): tiny calibration card (paste into spreadsheet or doc):
- Impact: High/Med/Low + 1-line evidence link
- Ownership: High/Med/Low + 1-line note on scope
- Risk: Green/Amber/Red + 1-line reason
Use this as three short columns per person.
Jordan (SWE): peer prompt for async asks? keep it minimal.
Alex (People Ops): async peer prompt (single message to peers):
"In 1-2 bullets: 1) one concrete thing they did that helped you ship (link if possible), 2) one small improvement suggestion." (48h turnaround requested).
Priya (PM): what's a short manager script for giving corrective mid-cycle feedback?
Alex (People Ops): corrective script (3 lines):
"I want to align on expectation X. Here's the evidence I see. Proposed change: do Y this cycle. I'll check in on Z-date."
Hina (Eng Manager): can we version these so teams don't diverge?
Alex (People Ops): version v4.1-goals. If you adapt, paste: new-tag + 1-line summary here.
Remy (People Ops Bot): Tip: schedule midpoint reminders with `/perf reminder add --when 2w-before-midpoint --team @team` or add to your calendar template. Docs: /docs/performance/checkins
Jordan (SWE): example filled self-review would help with tone.
Alex (People Ops): example (short):
```
Role & scope: Backend engineer, inference stack.
Top outcomes: 1) Cut 95p latency 22% (dash link). 2) Implemented cache ttl policy that saved $6k/mo (PR #789).
Learned: tradeoff between batch size and tail latency.
Blocker: infra quota for stress tests.
Growth ask: run next cross-team perf sync.
```
Priya (PM): will add these to our team handbook and post v4.1-teamA if we tweak for PMs.
Alex (People Ops): thanks — tiny ask: when you localize wording or change format (bullets vs paragraph), add "format:" note in the review header so calibrators know how to read it.
